page_title: BOL 3-2 TOR | Bologna v Torino 14/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Adam Masina (Torino). Michael Fabbri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+3' Bologna are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 3 - 2 Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) scores an unfortunate own goal and the opposition increase their lead!

89' Remo Freuler (Bologna) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
89' Remo Freuler (Bologna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
87' Here comes a substitution. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Nikola Moro.
87' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Calabria (Bologna) replacing Emil Holm.
86' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Che Adams (Torino) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' A substitution has been made. Tommaso Pobega is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
81' Substitution. Borna Sosa (Torino) makes his way off the pitch and Cristiano Biraghi comes on as his replacement.
81' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Adam Masina replaces Valentino Lazaro (Torino).

79' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
78' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

77' That was a nice football moment. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
76' Nikola Moro (Bologna) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
76' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
76' Substitution. Benjamin Dominguez is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
75' Juan Miranda (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away.
73' Eljif Elmas (Torino) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
70' 2 - 2 Goal! Dan Ndoye (Bologna) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
70' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
69' Cesare Casadei (Torino) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a penalty to Bologna! Let's see who's going to take it.
68' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
65' 1 - 2 Eljif Elmas (Torino) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Lukasz Skorupski with a strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:2.

64' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Dan Ndoye (Bologna) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
63' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
62' Here is a change. Karol Linetty is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
62' Substitution. Yann Karamoh did his best and is replaced by Eljif Elmas (Torino).
61' Michael Fabbri shows the yellow card to Yann Karamoh (Torino) for a heavy challenge.
60' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
58' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. Sam Beukema (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.
58' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
57' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
54' Problems for Paolo Vanoli as Sebastian Walukiewicz is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Marcus Pedersen (Torino) replaces him.
53' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Karol Linetty (Torino) picks up a yellow card.
50' Juan Miranda (Bologna) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Bologna win a corner kick.
50' Bologna show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
48' Cesare Casadei (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a switch. Nicolo Casale is coming on in place of Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) at the start of the second period.
46' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

44' That was close! Santiago Castro (Bologna) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
43' Remo Freuler (Bologna) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
40' A long ball forward to Che Adams (Torino) is intercepted.
39' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Juan Miranda (Bologna), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:1.
36' Nikola Moro (Bologna) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

33' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

31' Juan Miranda (Bologna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
30' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

28' Saul Coco (Torino) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
27' Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' Che Adams (Torino) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
25' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

23' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
23' Nikola Moro (Bologna) will take the corner.
23' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' 1 - 0 Dan Ndoye (Bologna) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
19' Juan Miranda (Bologna) works the corner short.
18' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Bologna get a corner.
17' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Michael Fabbri changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
16' Celebrations by Bologna are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
13' Karol Linetty (Torino) makes a slide tackle, but referee Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Bologna are awarded a penalty.
12' Bologna are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
9' Juan Miranda (Bologna) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Juan Miranda (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a throw-in.

5' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
2' Santiago Castro (Bologna) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
1' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Fabbri.
